title: Day 1 making a necromancer game
author: Upper-Philosophy2376
selftext:
forgive me that I'm still learning how to edit videos. 

Decided to make a necromancer game, been working on designing the skilltree for months, but figured a demo of the world wouldn't hurt. Used opencode - spacebunny model (which was free), I spent maybe 4 hours on it and stopped it once it fell into an optimization loop. It has height based terrain, and real time shadows with a day night system which will come in handy later.

Only implemented simple abilities a bonespear that shoots and raising skeletons, skeletons have half the hp of an enemy and a 20% chance to be destroyed on death otherwise revive after a bit. 

Going to be pulling inspiration from countless fantasy books. manga, manhwa, and videogames that have necromancers in them. So far gameplay-wise it's pulling from 'vampire survivors', 'v-rising', 'populous the beginning' and 'myth 2'. But more to come.

This will evolve a lot over time so let me know suggestions and recomendations for inspiration, thanks.
